name: Chubu Centrair International Airport
before:
Nagoya's international airport, built on an artificial island in Ise Bay about 35 km south of the city. It covers 470 hectares and works from a single 3,500 metre runway. The name Centrair is a contraction of Central Japan International Airport.

Terminal 1 splits neatly: domestic on the north side, international on the south, each with its own check in, security and baggage claim. Arrivals are on the second floor and departures on the third. Terminal 2 handles the budget airlines, domestic and international both, and opened in September 2019 with a shuttle bus linking the two.

What makes this one worth arriving early for is the fourth floor. Sky Town is open to anyone, not just passengers, with 61 shops and restaurants along two streets. One of them, Chochin-yokocho, is themed shop by shop to look like an old Japanese lane.

Next door, Flight of Dreams opened in 2018 around the first Boeing 787 Dreamliner prototype.
after:
Nagoya's international airport, built on an artificial island in Ise Bay about 35 km south of the city. It covers about 470 hectares and works from a single 3,500 metre runway.

Terminal 1 holds both domestic and international flights, with arrivals on the second floor and departures on the third.

What makes this one worth arriving early for is the fourth floor. Sky Town is open to anyone, not just passengers, with shops and restaurants in two streets, one of which recreates an old Japanese town.

Close by, Flight of Dreams is built around the first Boeing 787 Dreamliner.

claims.claim: Terminal 2 for budget airlines, opened September 2019, shuttle bus
claims.wasBefore: Terminal 2 handles the budget airlines, domestic and international both, and opened in September 2019 with a shuttle bus linking the two.
claims.why: Its current use could not be confirmed. The operator's site (centrair.jp) answers with Cloudflare's 'Just a moment...' bot check, so it was not tried further; Peach's and Jetstar's sites answered 502. Aichi's travel guide still lists Terminal 2 opening hours and says it may close when no flights are scheduled, but the page is undated and years old (it cites a 2020 award and covid-era hours). Owner to decide once the operator's site can be read.
